hud_hint_keys: F8 Click-Through · F9 Hide · Drag to Move
pace_early_note: Pre-7:30 · Early sample, use as directional guide
pace_late_note: 20:00+ · Late game, focus on live macro calls
call_smite_adv_detail: Enemy jungler down for {sec}s (no enemy Smite). Pull {objective} now.
call_smite_warn_detail: Ally jungler dead ({sec}s). Trade opposite map side or clear waves.
call_num_adv_detail: Enemy down ({enemy_dead} dead). Push towers or take {objective} before respawn.
call_num_disadv_detail: Outnumbered. Give outer objectives and clear waves safely.
call_soul_threat_detail: Enemy has {enemy_dragons} dragons. Group 45s early and clear river vision.
call_soul_point_detail: One dragon left for Soul. Set up bot river control before spawn.
call_grubs_window_detail: Topside objective active ({ally_grubs} grubs). Shove top/mid before rotating.
call_baron_window_detail: Enemy jungler down or outnumbered past 20:00. Sweep pit and start Baron.
call_carry_group_detail: Ally {lane} is ahead ({kills}K). Shadow and peel instead of solo forcing.
call_recall_gold_detail: Enough gold for a spike. Shove wave and reset before next objective.
call_counter_heal_detail: Heavy enemy healing/lifesteal detected. Grab an 800G Grievous component.
call_counter_tank_detail: Enemy stacking armor/HP. Plan percentage penetration as next core.
call_even_farm_detail: Game is close. Maintain CS lead and ward river before 14:00 plates fall.
